claims.answer: pitwall ships a fleet/orchestrator workflow and agent skill. A Claude Code or Codex leader creates worktree workers and waits for their results through pitwall commands. Install hooks/agent instructions, then ask the coding agent to split work across workers. Fleet mode and model lanes are enabled separately in Settings. pitwall send queues an addressed agent-to-agent message for a safe prompt point, including sender identity and a reply pane address. wait stops for completion or a blocked question; read returns the latest finished reply. Messages and cached replies have the daemon-memory retention limits documented by the skill.
